_comment: Defaults for builders. The client's own config.json overrides anything here — objects merge, arrays replace whole. Edit freely; nothing regenerates this.
responsePromise: We come back to every enquiry within a day.

process.detail: What you want, roughly what you want to spend, and whether the two meet. Better to find out now.
Drawings, then a detailed quote with the inclusions written down, so you are comparing like for like.
We deal with the certifier and the council so you are not chasing paperwork.
One site supervisor you can actually ring, and a schedule you can see.

faq.q: How much does an extension cost?
faq.a: It depends on size, site access and how much of the existing house gets touched. We give you a real number after we have seen it, not a per-square-metre guess over the phone.
Yes. Plans, certifier and council are part of the job.

faq.q: Can we live in the house during the build?
faq.a: Often yes, depending on what is being touched. We will be straight with you about what it will be like.
In writing, priced, and approved by you before the work happens. No surprises on the final invoice.
